In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the p210 BCR/ABL oncoprotein is able to activate the JNK pathway and that this activation is associated with the activation of the AP-1 transcription factor.
the c-jun/AP1 pathway is an important component in transformation by p210BCR-ABL.
p210 BCR/ABL induces a c-jun N- terminal kinase, and the kinase induces c-jun and its transcription factor, AP-1, in a cell type specific manner.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
p210 BCR/ABL activates c-jun/AP1 transcriptional activity through JNK.
c-jun/AP1 is a downstream target of JNK activity in p210 Bcr/Abl transformed cells.
p210 BCR/ABL activates the transcription factor JNK and that JNK in turn activates the transcription factor AP-1.
The main takeaway from our work is that

p210 BCR/ABL transforms hematopoietic progenitor cells by a mechanism involving activation of the c-junction N-terminal kinase, and that this mechanism is relevant for the development of acute leukemias.
p210 BCR/ABL activates the JNK/c-Jun signaling pathway in hematopoietically transformed cells.
p210 BCR/ABL activates c-jun and its downstream target genes in hematopoietically transformed cells.
